content:
alexcrichton opened PR #14685 from alexcrichton:cm-memory64-fixmes to bytecodealliance:main:

Wasmtime generally has no support for memory64 components at runtime, but my theoretical hope is that it'll be easier to implement this in the future if relevant locations are at least tagged with needing handling one way or another. This adds more comments throughout component-model-async bits to mirror what's already being done for the rest of the runtime.
